summary: WISeQey Corp., formerly WISeKey International Holding AG, filed a 6-K disclosing completion of its redomiciliation from Switzerland to the British Virgin Islands, with Nasdaq/SIX trading beginning October 5, 2026 under symbol WQEY. Its subsidiary WISeSat.Space Holdings Corp. (Nasdaq: SAIQ) separately listed via business combination, closing a $10 million PIPE with SEALSQ Corp at $10.79 per share, the redemption price. A price-protection mechanism may issue additional shares if the 10-day VWAP ending 60 days post-closing falls below $10.79, floored at $5.00, alongside customary lock-ups. Watch post-listing share overhang and price-protection dilution.
